settings.explain_customicons_doubleclick: Double click on a name to give it a description, which can be seen back at the bottom of the Device Settings.

virtualdevicesettings.labelIcons: Here you will get a list with the names you have customized, once you have changed names in the App Settings.
virtualdevicesettings.field-not-set: __fieldId__ has not been set. Goto Device Settings and add the field.

list_icons.set_icon_and_customize: Here you can select an icon (id) for your device. You can change the icon for each ID/number later through App Settings, but you cannot change which icon ID your device uses after creation. So pick a Unique number for each device. Any icon can be chosen for devices and capabilities, the categories are for clarity.  All icons can be set to any default icon through App Settings.
